title_zh: 询问退课前需要核对的学费规则

scenario.label_zh: 询问退课前需要核对的学费规则
scenario.goal_zh: 提出退课对学费影响的询问并约定发送适用政策后再作决定

context_zh: 虚构大学服务台沟通练习。具体政策尚未提供，对话不代表真实院校退款规则或财务建议。
author: author-phase12-c

sentences.speaker: Eva
sentences.text: I'm an undergraduate on the evening course. Where can I check how withdrawal would affect my tuition?

sentences.speaker: Mr Cole
sentences.text: I'll send you the policy for that course. Have you already submitted a request?

sentences.speaker: Eva
sentences.text: No. I'm trying to understand the consequences before I decide.

sentences.speaker: Mr Cole
sentences.text: That's clear. The policy will show the relevant dates, but I can't promise a refund without checking your situation.

sentences.speaker: Eva
sentences.text: Please send it first, then. I'll read it before taking any further step.

sentences.speaker: Mr Cole
sentences.text: Certainly. I'll include the contact for questions about the fees.
